name: The Spice & Tea Exchange of Kannapolis
tagline: Fine spices, more than 85 handcrafted seasonings hand-mixed in the store every day, loose-leaf teas, salts, sugars and gifts, with a tea bar
about: Owned and operated by Claire, the Kannapolis Spice & Tea Exchange stocks fine spices, handcrafted seasonings and rubs, loose-leaf teas, salts, sugars, gifts and accessories. Stop by to watch the Spice Masters mix the house blends by hand, or try something at the tea bar. Call or email an order for curbside pickup.
